Connect to perform

As an introduction, we organize an open game evening several times a year, often online these days, where our contacts and interested parties are welcome to become familiar with this methodology. (Participation is completely free and without further obligation). Through a login to our online learning portal, you gain access to videos with explanations and background information. Furthermore, experience shows it’s very interesting to exchange thoughts with people you haven’t met before, working in various organizations.
